posts.t:
Small update. Have been away from journal but not from trading. Only being in silence one can start to grasp who one is. Journal was too much of a distraction.

Not sure how to sum up what silence taught but something with in those lines: Less is more.

Will share 1 trade:
posts.fa:

posts.t:
Humo Sapiens is a strange creature. So I have this EURUSD open. Partial was closed. It is risk free, actually some +0.3R locked in no matter what now. Though EURUSD is moving against me now and I sweat, like mind creates this endless stream of bad scenarios!

It is funny and sad at the same time
posts.fa:
Homo Sapiens موجود عجیبی است. پس این EURUSD باز را دارم. جزئی بسته شد. بدون ریسک است، در واقع کمی +0.3R قفل شده دیگر مهم نیست. هرچند EURUSD الان علیه من حرکت می‌کند و عرق می‌کنم، مثل اینکه ذهن این جریان بی‌پایان سناریوهای بد می‌سازد!

هم خنده‌دار و هم غم‌انگیز است
